combo_label: Jobs & Professions × Camping & the Outdoors × Mr Men & Little Miss

entries.clue: Nylon room on poles, pitched for a night in a field
Drafts the contract, then stands up to argue your case in court
Spring-gated metal loop joining a climber to the rope
Glass-sided glow you hang from a ridgepole once dusk falls
Roger Hargreaves' orange chap with impossibly long arms; what a feather does
Little Miss so small she lives in a mousehole at Home Farm; minute indeed
Hargreaves' vast pink fellow who eats the lot and eyes up your plate too
Rises at three to prove the dough so the town wakes to warm loaves
Blue star-shaped Hargreaves chap from chilly Coldland; one sudden red-nosed achoo
Checks the chart, changes the drip and works the night shift on the ward
